Core Meaning & Life Stage: Fetal energy (3 pts). New beginnings from endings. Highly intuitive, multi-talented, spiritually gifted. Turbulent but rich life.
Strengths: Intuitive & multi-talented; spiritually gifted; bridges endings and new beginnings
Challenges: Turbulent life; feelings of misunderstanding; difficulty committing long-term

Core Meaning & Life Stage: Infant energy (6 pts). Natural magnetism draws support without effort. Lucky through distant sources. Full potential realized in later years.
Strengths: Natural magnetism; draws support; lucky from unexpected sources; calm in difficulty
Challenges: Must distinguish sincere allies from opportunists; full potential only in later years

Core Meaning & Life Stage: Childhood energy (9 pts). Endowed with talent and refinement. Greatest gift passed to next generation. Stable, peaceful presence.
Strengths: Gifted with talent & refinement; brings luck to descendants; creates stable peaceful environment
Challenges: Personal achievements may be modest; purpose is generational rather than individual

Core Meaning & Life Stage: Adolescent energy (7 pts). Refined aesthetic sensibility. Thrives internationally. Luck comes through indirect/side-door paths.
Strengths: Refined aesthetic; thrives internationally; lucky through indirect paths
Challenges: Luck pathways are unclear; benefits most from overseas/cross-cultural context

Core Meaning & Life Stage: Young adult energy (10 pts). High service-orientation. Remains active well into old age. Success through patient decades-long dedication.
Strengths: High service-orientation; remains active throughout life; success through patient decades-long dedication
Challenges: May avoid leadership; taken for granted for reliability; life gets BUSIER with age not calmer

Core Meaning & Life Stage: Prime adult energy (11 pts). Stable prosperity and multi-generational family impact. Commands respect naturally.
Strengths: Stable prosperity; multi-generational family impact; commands natural respect
Challenges: Family may benefit more than person; risk of complacency in stable circumstances

Core Meaning & Life Stage: Peak energy (12 pts — HIGHEST). Frontrunner in chosen field. Remains professionally vital throughout life. Cost: personal/family life may suffer.
Strengths: Maximum vitality; frontrunner in chosen field; remains professionally vital throughout life
Challenges: Professional peak at cost of personal/family life; difficulty accepting vulnerability

Core Meaning & Life Stage: Elder energy (8 pts). Builds legacy and creates successors. Wisdom compounds. Comfortable and impactful in later years.
Strengths: Legacy-builder; creates successors; wisdom compounds; comfortable and impactful in later years
Challenges: Better at continuing than starting; contributions may not receive personal glory

Core Meaning & Life Stage: Dream-world energy (4 pts). Rich inner world. Can build entirely new cultural realms. Risk: escapism and loss of practicality.
Strengths: Exceptional creative imagination; builds entirely new cultural/artistic worlds
Challenges: Risk: escapism, fantasy, loss of practicality; may be misunderstood by society

Core Meaning & Life Stage: Dissolution energy (2 pts). Transcendence through letting go. Help from community not family. Profound spiritual potential.
Strengths: Profound spiritual depth; transcends ego; potential for deep wisdom and community reverence
Challenges: Family role unclear; conventional success paths inaccessible; requires spiritual framework

Core Meaning & Life Stage: Repository energy (5 pts). Remains active and duty-driven throughout life. Deep responsibility to next generation. Creates enduring institutions.
Strengths: Active throughout life; preserves and transmits knowledge; creates enduring institutions
Challenges: Cannot retire — constant sense of duty; sacrifices personal happiness; risks overbearing authority

Core Meaning & Life Stage: Wandering energy (1 pt — LOWEST). Consistent lifelong motion. Never fully settles. Excellent at mobilising others.
Strengths: Consistent work ethic lifelong; excellent at mobilising others; operates across many environments
Challenges: Cannot settle; family life suffers; lowest vitality — requires conscious energy management
